name: StateVerification
summary: Verifies by looking at what the system under test holds afterwards, so that a test asserts about the result rather than about the journey.

roles.name: StateVerification
roles.summary: A test that checks the state left behind. It couples to what the system is rather than to how it works, so a refactoring that changes the calls and keeps the outcome leaves it passing — which is the whole argument for it, and the reason it cannot catch an effect that leaves no trace.
